physical.objective_constraint: nprobe must be >= 1 for IVF search (cannot probe 0 clusters), ef must be >= 1 for HNSW search (cannot search with ef < 1)

verdicts.rationale: Milvus REST v2 API entities/search endpoint accepts invalid search parameter values without validation. Source code analysis confirms generateSearchParams() in utils.go passes all parameters through without range checking. Physical constraints are violated: nprobe=0 is invalid for IVF (must probe >= 1 clusters), ef=-1 and ef=0 are invalid for HNSW (must be >= 1). Multiple independent reproduction tests confirm API accepts these values with HTTP 200. This is a genuine Type1_IllegalSuccess defect matching the historical REST v2 data type handling blindspot pattern.
